outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrograph images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); it contains no bar/summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) showing only mean+error bars with no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D contains bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity (with n values shown in bars) displaying only means with error bars, without individual data points overlaid.

The FACS histograms in Panel E are distribution/line-type plots (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) showing the full data distribution rather than averaged summary statistics, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
